subject: Estimate and information?
body:
Hi Andres,

Hope all is well with you. Please accept my apology for not getting back to you sooner. I'm very excited about this opportunity and I hope we can work together on the project(s) we discussed. Below are the quotes I provided during our meeting:

Avicenna license to collect unlimited surveys with unlimited reminders for 28 days during a 2-year project:
- 50 participants: USD 780
- 60 participants: USD 936

We also talked about an annual subscription license that allows you and your team to run as many projects as they want. We can set the quota of this license to whatever makes sense to you, given the number of projects you plan to run each year. Here is an example for your reference:

An annual subscription license to collect survey data from up to 2,500 participants/week would cost about USD 2,316. Each participant/week is the amount of data you can collect from 1 participant during 1 week. You can use this quota in any way you like. Below are a few examples:

- 1 study with 2,500 participants for 1 week of data collection
- 5 studies with 500 participants for 1 week of data collection
- 5 studies with 100 participants for 5 weeks of data collection
- 25 studies with 50 participants for 2 weeks of data collection

Please note that you can present image, voice, and video content in all of our surveys and collect the same data as well. These features are included in all of our licenses.

As promised, if you think our platform can help your colleagues as well, I'd be more than happy to visit your office and hold a workshop. We can discuss what services and features we can offer to help your team with your upcoming projects.

I also attached a document to help you with the IRB application. If you need anything else from our side, please contact me. I'm always available for a quick chat and my calendar is shared here.

Best,
Amin
